limits: Single process conditional count-N stage. Native context construction and Stronghold discovery are excluded; cache reset/construction and misses are included. Count1 Stronghold uses the preselected anchor; count2+ enumerates/deduplicates its bounded predicted anchors. Individual family timings are single-pass means and exploratory; combination timings are five counterbalanced repeated trials. Structure family association is the biome at the logged start column and declared Y, not a claim that every structure piece lies in that family. Predictor parity is not actual-world certification.
